name: Done.ai Group AB
summary: Done.ai Group AB engages in the development and sale of software as a service (SaaS) solutions. The firm offers enterprise resource planning through cloud-based services to small and medium sized enterprises. Its solutions include project and time management, mobile, accounting, customer relationship management, reporting, integrations, and payroll. The company was founded on August 2, 2017 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.
